case_title: DARSHAN SINGH v. STATE OF PUNJAB
aggravating_circumstances: Not being available in the village post-death, disfigurement of the body with acid, failure to attend cremation and prayer ceremony
neutral_facts: The deceased, a woman, was found dead in a jute bag in a field. The body was decomposed and identified by clothing. The deceased was the mother of one accused and the wife of another. The accused were not happy with the deceased's inheritance of land from her deceased son. The deceased had sold one bigha of land and leased the remaining four bighas to her son, who was not paying the lease money. The accused were not present in the village soon after the incident, did not attend the cremation or prayer ceremony, and the body showed signs of acid attack and disfigurement. The accused were convicted based on an extra-judicial confession and medical evidence showing injuries consistent with the confession.
